verdict.rationale: Mintlify's pricing page lists "Authentication" as a platform feature and "SSO, SCIM & RBAC" on the enterprise tier. That suggests first-party docs gating, but the pack has no documentation of how reader authentication works, and the SSO line may refer to dashboard or team login rather than reader access. Missing for 10: documentation of password, JWT, and SSO reader-auth methods, gating some versus all pages, clarification that the SSO applies to reader access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I gate some or all docs behind authentication — password, JWT, or SSO — for customers-only content
